scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build:client: npm install --include=dev --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --include=dev --prefix client
scripts.start: npm run build:client && npm start --prefix server
scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix server && npm install --include=dev --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
